headline: Cardano Foundation Requests $5 Million From Treasury Above Market Token Value
summary: The Cardano Foundation submitted a funding proposal seeking 25 million ADA from the project's decentralized treasury, using an assumed token price 33% above current market levels near 20 cents.
why: Cardano is a prominent layer-1 blockchain, and contentious treasury allocation proposals can impact governance participation and token supply dynamics.

impacts.name: Cardano
impacts.why: Treasury funding requests above prevailing market rates draw community debate over governance dilution and spending.
